mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM spot) AS spotCount, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT city) FROM spot WHERE city IS NOT NULL AND city <> '') AS cityCount
SELECT rank_level AS rankLevel, COUNT(*) AS spotCount FROM spot GROUP BY rank_level
SELECT MONTH(visited_at) AS monthNo, COUNT(*) AS visitCount FROM visit WHERE YEAR(visited_at) = #{year} GROUP BY MONTH(visited_at)

SELECT s.id AS id, s.name AS name, s.avatar AS avatar, COUNT(*) AS visitCount, MAX(v.visited_at) AS lastVisitAt FROM visit v JOIN spot s ON s.id = v.spot_id GROUP BY s.id, s.name, s.avatar ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, MAX(v.visited_at) DESC LIMIT #{limit}
